name: cavemio-tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: A name and shortcut for an icon. The first one waits; after that they glide from trigger to trigger like one label travelling along the toolbar.

cavemio.usage:
import { Tooltip } from "@/components/tooltip";

<Tooltip content="Archive" shortcut="E">
  <button aria-label="Archive"><ArchiveIcon /></button>
</Tooltip>
cavemio.accessibility:
- Placement, presence and dismissal live in floating.ts, shared by tooltip, popover, dropdown and context menus: they all flip, shift, enter and leave the same way.
- Touch never shows a tooltip: put anything important in the label itself.
- Reduced motion: it fades, no glide.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

features.title: Warm glide
features.description: Within 450ms of the last one, the next shows at once and slides over from its position.

features.title: Placement
features.description: Flips to the other side and shifts to stay 8px inside the window.

features.title: Shortcuts
features.description: A kbd after the label, dimmed.

features.title: Accessible
features.description: role="tooltip" and aria-describedby on the trigger; focus-visible shows it.

states.title: first
states.description: After 500ms on the trigger it rises 6px from the side it sits on, out of a 4px blur, from 0.96 (320ms).

states.title: warm
states.description: The next trigger's tooltip shows at once and glides from the previous position (300ms).

states.title: hidden
states.description: Leaving, a press or Escape fades it (140ms).
